author: harness-architect
non_claims: Nothing in this design is implemented, deployed, migrated or measured.
No model call, Craft command, service unit or database table was created by this task.
The DeepSeek credential was observed by environment variable name only; its value was never read, echoed or logged.
Learning is not claimed: no A/B, no held-out result, no human study exists yet.
Only VectorCraft 0.21.1 and PhotoCraft 0.20.2 are installed; FilmCraft, DesignCraft and EffectCraft capability is unverified.
No dollar figure or timeline here is measured; both are estimates pending the Phase 0 baseline.

planes: Playwright MCP accessibility-snapshot fallback (declared only, read-back mandatory)
tool_layer.resolution: absolute path plus version probe plus binary sha256 pinned per episode; bare command names forbidden

roots.policy: realpath before root check; symlink escape is E_ROOT_DENIED; sources hashed before and after each batch

tool_layer.idempotency: sha256(episode_id + tool_id + canonical params + input hashes); unique index; replay returns stored result; publish needs a second human-issued key

verification.verdict_rule: pass requires rungs 1-5 green and, for print/publish/promotion, rung 6; any missing rung is unverified; rung 3 versus rung 5 disagreement is needs_human
anti_trust_rules: exit 0 is a process claim, never an effect claim
a screenshot can only downgrade a verdict, never upgrade it
vacuous gate passes are rejected from an independent text-presence probe
input hash checked before and after every batch; mutation quarantines the episode
vector artifacts re-rendered independently and compared by perceptual hash
critic is blind to exit codes, gate reports, prior verdicts and operator claims
critic output is schema-rejected if any dimension lacks crop evidence or any gate value is mentioned

case_retrieval.method: metadata filter, BM25 tsvector, optional real[] cosine, rerank by outcome/gate/recency/failure affinity, inject <=1200 tokens

rules.draft_to_candidate: 1 verified episode plus explicit scope and failure conditions
rules.candidate_to_active: 3 independent successes plus golden regression pass plus human sign-off
rules.active_to_superseded: new version promoted; old version kept and replayable
rules.active_to_rolled_back: failure, regression or contradiction; pointer flip plus goldens re-run

fine_tuning.status: not planned; optional Phase 3 only if retrieval plateaus

rl_on_gates.reason: gates measure technical correctness, not taste; optimising them produces gate-passing art

not_learning.claim_rule: learns means a held-out gain that persists across briefs and survives rollback; otherwise say retrieves cases and reuses vetted procedures

metrics.definition: accepted on attempt 1 divided by goldens attempted, pass means rungs 1-5 and 6 where required
tokens in and out at verified price plus wall seconds of CPU value
human-accepted divided by runs marked pass
refusals matching the expected refusal on negative fixtures
pass rate arm B minus arm A with 95 percent CI
verdict flips on identical inputs for the same prompt version

transition_guards.planned: ArtSpec with cited brand facts and success criteria
transition_guards.accepted: arbitration agrees and human approval where required

risks.risk: The critic false-passes bad art because deepseek-flash vision is untested on print defects, making the evidence ladder ceremonial
risks.mitigation: 50-defect labelled corpus before Phase 2 sign-off; measure false-pass rate; human review until measured; critic verdict can never override a failed gate

risks.risk: Gates and metrics get optimised instead of art quality (reward hacking)
risks.mitigation: private held-out goldens, verifier/operator separation, vacuity and threshold-hugging checks, human rubric, no RL

risks.risk: 2 vCPU host is overloaded; Craft steps starve the shop app or DeerFlow
risks.mitigation: one global craft semaphore, two episodes max, nice and ionice, 900 s timeouts, cgroup limits, daily cost and CPU review

risks.risk: Craft CLI stdout/stderr is not a stable machine interface, so error mapping and gates mis-classify failures
risks.mitigation: snapshot 20 commands per app, pin envelope format, fail closed on unparseable output, never regex a success message

risks.risk: Only two of five Craft apps are installed, so the multi-app supervision claim is overreach
risks.mitigation: E_UNSUPPORTED_SURFACE until installation plus catalogue snapshot plus smoke task; keep FilmCraft out of scope

risks.risk: Memory poisoning: a single verified-looking case or brand fact propagates to many runs
risks.mitigation: hash-chained ledger, provenance on facts, three independent successes plus human sign-off, contradiction records, kill switch and rollback drill

risks.risk: Secret leakage into prompts, logs or argv
risks.mitigation: env-file only, redaction tests in CI, no secrets in tool results, rotate on any exposure

risks.risk: Prompt injection from brief, OCR, EXIF or metadata changes tool policy
risks.mitigation: treat all external text as data, delimit, never insert into policy or system prompts, log untrusted content separately

risks.risk: Disk exhaustion: artifacts and logs fill a 63 percent full disk
risks.mitigation: 10 GB quota, content-addressed store, GC after 90 days with dry-run, bounded logs, daily disk alert

risks.risk: Retrieval has no lift and adds tokens and latency
risks.mitigation: A/B with CI; a null result disables retrieval by default; findings recorded rather than hidden

risks.risk: The existing published shims hide a broken CLI wiring, so a demo can look green while exiting 127
risks.mitigation: absolute-path resolution and version probes; a step with exit 127 is a refusal, never a pass; Phase 0 replaces the shims

risks.risk: Rights and data-protection violations from fixtures or customer art
risks.mitigation: rights id required per input, curated public-domain or owned fixtures, retention limits, no training on customer data

env_names_only.rule: names only in this design; values live in a root-owned environment file and are never committed, logged or echoed
